context: Dalyria and Pale Petras are two vampire spawn who confront Astarion at the flophouse where they used to "hunt"; this scene can occur whether Astarion is present as the player‑Avatar or as a companion. They demand Astarion tell Cazador that he's back in the city and warn that Cazador is preparing a Black Mass ritual that will call all the spawn and—supposedly—grant them new powers and freedom. If Astarion (and the player) already know Cazador actually intends to sacrifice the spawn, Astarion may be able to convince the others to resist; in return Dalyria and Petras will share limited information about the palace and the ritual. After the exchange they vanish as clouds of mist, and the scene is colored by Astarion’s history as a tormented spawn of Cazador and the other spawn’s fearful hope for ascension.
